title: Heriot-Watt University
description: Heriot-Watt University's official brand guidelines define the primary colours Heriot Blue (#0A3E65), Heriot Blue Bright (#0095DB), Heriot Blue Dark (#031B39), Heriot Blue Shade (#C4CEDE), White (#FFFFFF) and Castle Stone (#6A5B49), and the secondary colours Holyrood Green (#2C642C), Orkney Sand (#B25A22), Rose Pink (#D32D5C) and Highlands Orchil (#782066).
